newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Mosaic says gas well holds reservoirs.
newsitem.headline: Mosaic says gas well holds reservoirs.

text.p: Mosaic Oil NL said on Thursday that its Downlands-2 gas appraisal well in the Surat Basin of Queensland had reached a depth of 1,900 metres indicating about seven metres of net gas pay with good reservoir quality.
The hole is to be cased and suspended as a gas discovery, Mosaic said.
A workover rig had been booked for production testing later this month, the company said.
Operator Mosaic has a 28.89 percent interest in the well, OGM Development 42.22 percent, Santos Ltd 16.67 percent and Petroz NL 12.22 percent.
